source.text: שַׁאֲל֨וּ מֵיְהוָ֤ה מָטָר֙ בְּעֵ֣ת מַלְק֔וֹשׁ יְהוָ֖ה עֹשֶׂ֣ה חֲזִיזִ֑ים וּמְטַר־גֶּ֨שֶׁם֙ יִתֵּ֣ן לָהֶ֔ם לְאִ֖ישׁ עֵ֥שֶׂב בַּשָּׂדֶֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: Ask from Yahweh rain in [the] time of [the] spring rain; Yahweh [is] making storm clouds, and showers of rain he gives to them, to each [one the] vegetation in the field.

en.L: Ask rain from {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} in the time of the spring rain; \q {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} [is the one] making the storm clouds, \q and showers of rain {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} gives to them, \q to everyone the vegetation in the field.
en.B: Ask {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} for rain in the season of the spring rain. \q It is {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} who makes the storm clouds; \q {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} gives them showers of rain \q and green plants in the field for everyone.
en.R: Ask {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} for rain in the spring. \q {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} is the one who makes the storm clouds. \q He sends showers of rain \q and makes the plants in the fields grow for everyone.

fr.L: Demandez {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} la pluie au temps de la pluie de printemps ; \q {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} [est celui qui] fait les nuages d’orage, \q et des averses de pluie, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les leur donne, \q à chacun l’herbe dans les champs.
fr.B: Demandez {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} la pluie à la saison des pluies de printemps. \q C’est {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} qui forme les nuages d’orage ; \q {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} leur donne des averses de pluie \q et l’herbe verte dans les champs pour chacun.
fr.R: Demandez {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} de faire pleuvoir au printemps. \q C’est {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} qui forme les nuages d’orage. \q Il envoie des averses de pluie \q et fait pousser les plantes dans les champs pour tout le monde.

es.L: {{plural_you:Pidan|Pedid}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} lluvia en el tiempo de la lluvia de primavera; \q {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} [es quien] hace los nubarrones, \q y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} les da aguaceros, \q a cada uno la hierba en el campo.
es.B: {{plural_you:Pídanle|Pedidle}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} lluvia en la estación de la lluvia de primavera. \q Es {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} quien hace los nubarrones; \q {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} les da aguaceros \q y hierba verde en el campo para todos.
es.R: {{plural_you:Pídanle|Pedidle}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} que mande lluvia en la primavera. \q {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} es quien forma las nubes de tormenta. \q Él manda aguaceros \q y hace crecer las plantas en los campos para todos.

vi.L: Hãy xin mưa từ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} trong mùa mưa xuân; \q {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} [là Đấng] làm ra mây giông, \q và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ban cho họ những trận mưa rào, \q cho mỗi người cây cỏ ngoài đồng.
vi.B: Hãy cầu xin {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ban mưa trong mùa mưa xuân. \q Chính {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} làm ra mây giông; \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ban cho họ những trận mưa rào \q và cây cỏ xanh tươi ngoài đồng cho mọi người.
vi.R: Hãy cầu xin {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ban mưa vào mùa xuân. \q Chính {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} là Đấng làm ra mây mưa. \q Ngài ban những trận mưa rào \q và làm cho cây cỏ ngoài đồng mọc lên cho mọi người.

sw.L: Ombeni mvua kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wakati wa mvua za masika; \q {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} [ndiye] afanyaye mawingu ya dhoruba, \q {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} huwapa manyunyu ya mvua, \q kila mtu mimea shambani.
sw.B: Mwombeni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} mvua wakati wa mvua za masika. \q Ni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anayefanya mawingu ya dhoruba; \q huwapa manyunyu ya mvua \q na mimea ya kijani shambani kwa kila mtu.
sw.R: Mwombeni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} mvua wakati wa masika. \q {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ndiye anayefanya mawingu ya dhoruba. \q Yeye huleta manyunyu ya mvua \q na kuifanya mimea ya mashambani imee kwa ajili ya kila mtu.

ko.L: 늦은 비가 내릴 때에 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 비를 구하여라. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 먹구름을 만드시고, \q 그들에게 소낙비를 주시며, \q 각 사람에게 밭의 채소를 [주신다].
ko.B: 봄비가 내릴 철에 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 비를 구하여라. \q 먹구름을 만드시는 분은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}이시다. \q 그분께서 사람들에게 소낙비를 내려 주시고, \q 누구에게나 들에 푸른 풀이 돋게 하신다.
ko.R: 봄에 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 비를 내려 달라고 구하여라. \q 비구름을 만드시는 분은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}이시다. \q 그분께서 소나기를 내려 주시고, \q 모든 사람을 위해 들에 곡식과 풀이 자라게 하신다.

pt.L: Peçam chuva {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}} no tempo da chuva da primavera; \q {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} [é quem] faz as nuvens de tempestade, \q e aguaceiros de chuva {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} lhes dá, \q a cada um a vegetação no campo.
pt.B: Peçam {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}} chuva na estação da chuva da primavera. \q É {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} quem faz as nuvens de tempestade; \q {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} lhes dá aguaceiros de chuva \q e plantas verdes no campo para todos.
pt.R: Peçam {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}} que mande chuva na primavera. \q {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} é quem faz as nuvens de tempestade. \q Ele manda pancadas de chuva \q e faz crescer as plantas nos campos para todos.

am.L: በኋለኛው ዝናብ ጊዜ {{divine_name:ከእግዚአብሔር|ከያህዌ}} ዝናብን ለምኑ፤ \q ነጎድጓዳማ ደመናዎችን የሚያደርግ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} [ነው]፤ \q የዝናብንም ዶፍ ይሰጣቸዋል፤ \q ለእያንዳንዱም በሜዳ ያለውን ልምላሜ [ይሰጣል]።
am.B: በበልግ ዝናብ ወራት {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} ዝናብን ለምኑት። \q ነጎድጓዳማ ደመናዎችን የሚያደርግ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ነው፤ \q የዝናብ ዶፍ ይሰጣቸዋል፤ \q ለሁሉም በሜዳ ላይ ልምላሜን ያበቅላል።
am.R: በበልግ ወራት ዝናብ እንዲሰጣችሁ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} ለምኑት። \q ዝናብ የሚያመጡትን ደመናዎች የሚያደርግ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ነው። \q እርሱ የዝናብ ዶፍ ይልካል፤ \q በእርሻ ያሉትንም ተክሎች ለሁሉም ያበቅላል።

hi.L: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} से पिछली वर्षा के समय में वर्षा माँगो; \q {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ही बिजली के बादल बनाते हैं, \q और वे उन्हें वर्षा की झड़ियाँ देते हैं, \q हर एक को खेत में हरियाली।
hi.B: पिछली वर्षा की ऋतु में {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} से वर्षा माँगो। \q {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ही गरजनेवाले बादल बनाते हैं; \q वे उन्हें वर्षा की बौछारें देते हैं \q और हर एक के लिए खेत में हरियाली उगाते हैं।
hi.R: वसंत में {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} से वर्षा माँगो। \q {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ही वर्षा लानेवाले बादल बनाते हैं। \q वे वर्षा की बौछारें भेजते हैं \q और सबके लिए खेतों में पौधे उगाते हैं।

ru.L: Просите у {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} дождя во время весеннего дождя; \q {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} [— тот, кто] творит грозовые тучи, \q и ливни дождя {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} даёт им, \q каждому — зелень на поле.
ru.B: Просите у {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} дождя в пору весенних дождей. \q Это {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} творит грозовые тучи; \q {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} даёт им проливной дождь \q и каждому — зелень на поле.
ru.R: Просите у {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} дождя весной. \q {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} — тот, кто собирает грозовые тучи. \q Он посылает проливные дожди \q и даёт всем растения на полях.

ja.L: 春の雨の時に、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に雨を求めよ。 \q {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は嵐の雲を造られる方、 \q 彼らに大雨を与え、 \q すべての人に野の草を[与えられる]。
ja.B: 春の雨の季節に、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に雨を求めなさい。 \q 嵐の雲を造られるのは{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}である。 \q その方は彼らに大雨を降らせ、 \q すべての人のために野に青草を与えられる。
ja.R: 春には、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に雨を求めなさい。 \q 嵐の雲を造られるのは、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}だ。 \q その方は、雨をたくさん降らせて、 \q すべての人のために、畑の作物を育ててくださる。

uk.L: Просіть дощу від {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}} в час весняного дощу; \q {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} [той, хто] творить грозові хмари, \q і зливи дощу {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} дає їм, \q кожному траву на полі.
uk.B: Просіть у {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}} дощу в пору весняного дощу. \q Саме {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} творить грозові хмари; \q {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} дає їм зливи дощу \q і зелень на полі для кожного.
uk.R: Просіть у {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}} дощу навесні. \q Саме {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} творить грозові хмари. \q Він посилає зливи дощу \q і дає всім рослинам на полях рости.

decisions.choice: the spring rain: the last rains of the season, in March and April
decisions.reason: In the land of Israel rain falls only in the winter half of the year. The early rain of autumn softens the ground for plowing, and the late rain of spring swells the grain before harvest (Deuteronomy 11:14; Joel 2:23). Without the spring rain the harvest failed.

decisions.choice: ask rain from the LORD: the LORD, not the idols, gives the rain
decisions.reason: Many in Israel had looked to Baal, the storm god of Canaan, or to household gods and diviners, for rain and harvest (verse 2; Hosea 2:7-10; Jeremiah 14:22). The prophet calls the people to ask the LORD, who makes the storm clouds and gives the rain. It is a call back to trust in him.

decisions.choice: storm clouds: the thunderclouds that bring rain
decisions.reason: The word is used for the thunderbolt or the storm cloud that goes before the rain (Job 28:26; 38:25). The LORD makes the storm and sends the showers.

decisions.choice: It is the LORD who makes (B); green plants ... grow (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew puts the LORD's name first for emphasis, which Balanced gives as "It is the LORD who" and Readable as "The LORD is the one who". Balanced and Readable say "green plants" for the field's vegetation.

decisions.choice: "la pluie de printemps" for malqosh
decisions.reason: The modern French name for the season of the last rains, which the meaning decision places in March and April.

decisions.choice: "la lluvia de primavera"
decisions.reason: The late rains are "lluvia de primavera", as in Hosea 6:3 in Spanish; the call is plural and takes plural_you.

decisions.choice: "늦은 비" (L); "봄비" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Malqosh is the last rain of the season in spring (meaning decision); Literal keeps the Bible term, B and R say when it falls. After a span "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}이시다" reads after both forms.

decisions.choice: "mùa mưa xuân" (L, B) / "vào mùa xuân" (R) for the spring rain
decisions.reason: The latter rain falls in March and April; "mưa xuân" places it for Vietnamese readers without a technical term.

decisions.choice: "mvua za masika" for the spring rain
decisions.reason: The latter rains of March and April fall in the long rainy season that Swahili calls "masika"; the word needs no explanation for East African readers.

decisions.choice: "huwapa" with no deity_pronoun span; "naye" (L) with the span
decisions.reason: The English "he" is the Swahili subject prefix "a-/hu-", which cannot carry a capital (Swahili style guide 7), so Balanced has no span here; at Literal the joined free pronoun "naye" stands in the middle of the sentence and takes it, as the book-wide rule at 1:3.

decisions.choice: a chuva da primavera
decisions.reason: The late rain (m1) is "a chuva da primavera" at every level, as the English says "spring rain"; "chuva serôdia", the old Bible word, is not understood today. Readable says "pancadas de chuva", the everyday Brazilian word for showers.

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun spans in Amharic
decisions.reason: The Ethiopic script has no capital letters, so the setting that capitalizes pronouns for God has nothing to change; the English spans on "he", "his", "me" and "my" in this chapter have no Amharic counterpart.

decisions.choice: the spring rain (malqosh) "በልግ ዝናብ", as Hosea 6:3 on main; storm clouds "ነጎድጓዳማ ደመናዎች" (L, B)
decisions.reason: The last rains of the season (March and April, the meaning decision) fall in the months Ethiopians call "በልግ", the short rains, so the word says both the season and the rain. Jeremiah 3:3 on main has "የኋለኛው ዝናብ".

decisions.choice: पिछली वर्षा (L, B); वसंत (R)
decisions.reason: The malqosh is the last rain of the season, in March and April (meaning m1), पिछली वर्षा as Deuteronomy 11:14 in this translation; Readable gives the season, as the English "in the spring".

decisions.choice: No deity_pronoun spans in Hindi
decisions.reason: Where the English marks God's pronouns with the deity_pronoun setting, the Hindi has no spans: Devanagari has no capital letters, and respect for God is carried by the honorific third person (वे, उनका). This holds for every record of this file.

decisions.choice: весенний дождь (L, B); весной (R)
decisions.reason: The last rains of the season, in March and April (m1); "весенний" says when they fall, as the English "spring rain".

decisions.choice: malqosh "春の雨" (every level, as Jeremiah 3:3); chazizim "嵐の雲"; 'esev "野の草" (L), "青草" (B), "畑の作物" (R); sha'alu "求めよ" (L), "求めなさい" (B, R).
decisions.reason: The prophet's own call to the people (m2): light respect forms for the LORD (造られる, 与えられる), as the convention for the prophet's words; commands per level.

source.text: כִּ֧י הַתְּרָפִ֣ים דִּבְּרוּ־אָ֗וֶן וְהַקּֽוֹסְמִים֙ חָ֣זוּ שֶׁ֔קֶר וַֽחֲלֹמוֹת֙ הַשָּׁ֣ואיְדַבֵּ֔רוּ הֶ֖בֶל יְנַֽחֵמ֑וּן עַל־כֵּן֙ נָסְע֣וּ כְמוֹ־צֹ֔אן יַעֲנ֖וּ כִּֽי־אֵ֥ין רֹעֶֽה׃פ

records.literal_gloss: For the teraphim speak wickedness, and the diviners see falsehood, and dreams of worthlessness they speak, [with] futility they comfort; therefore they set out like sheep, they are afflicted, for there is no shepherd.

en.L: For the teraphim speak wickedness, and the diviners see falsehood; \q and they speak worthless dreams; \q they comfort in vain. \q Therefore they set out like sheep; \q they are afflicted, for there is no shepherd.
en.B: For the household gods speak deceit, and the diviners see lies; \q they tell dreams that are false \q and give comfort that is empty. \q So the people wander off like sheep; \q they suffer because they have no shepherd.
en.R: The household idols give answers that cannot be trusted, and the fortune-tellers see visions that are lies. \q They tell dreams that mean nothing. \q The comfort they give is useless. \q So the people wander like lost sheep. \q They suffer because they have no shepherd to lead them.

fr.L: Car les téraphim disent la tromperie, et les devins voient le mensonge ; \q et ils racontent des rêves sans valeur ; \q ils consolent en vain. \q C’est pourquoi ils sont partis comme des brebis ; \q ils sont malheureux, car il n’y a pas de berger.
fr.B: Car les dieux domestiques ne disent que tromperie, et les devins voient des mensonges ; \q ils racontent des rêves trompeurs \q et donnent des consolations vides. \q Alors le peuple erre comme des brebis ; \q il souffre parce qu’il n’a pas de berger.
fr.R: Les idoles domestiques donnent des réponses auxquelles on ne peut pas se fier, et les devins ont des visions qui sont des mensonges. \q Ils racontent des rêves qui ne veulent rien dire. \q Leurs consolations ne servent à rien. \q Alors le peuple erre comme des moutons perdus. \q Il souffre parce qu’il n’a pas de berger pour le conduire.

es.L: Porque los dioses domésticos hablan iniquidad, y los adivinos ven mentira; \q y cuentan sueños vanos; \q consuelan en vano. \q Por eso se van como ovejas; \q andan afligidos, porque no hay pastor.
es.B: Porque los ídolos domésticos hablan engaño, y los adivinos ven mentiras; \q cuentan sueños falsos \q y dan un consuelo vacío. \q Por eso el pueblo anda errante como ovejas; \q sufre porque no tiene pastor.
es.R: Los ídolos domésticos dan respuestas en las que no se puede confiar, y los adivinos ven visiones que son mentira. \q Cuentan sueños que no significan nada. \q El consuelo que dan no sirve para nada. \q Por eso el pueblo anda como ovejas perdidas. \q Sufre porque no tiene un pastor que lo guíe.

vi.L: Vì các thê-ra-phim nói điều gian ác, và các thầy bói thấy điều giả dối; \q chúng nói những giấc mộng hư không, \q chúng an ủi cách vô ích. \q Vì vậy, chúng lang thang như chiên; \q chúng bị khốn khổ vì không có người chăn.
vi.B: Vì các tượng thần gia đình nói điều dối trá, và các thầy bói thấy điều giả dối; \q chúng kể những giấc mộng giả, \q và an ủi bằng lời trống rỗng. \q Vì vậy dân chúng lạc lối như chiên; \q họ khốn khổ vì không có người chăn.
vi.R: Các tượng thần trong nhà đưa ra những lời đáp không thể tin được, và các thầy bói thấy những khải tượng dối trá. \q Chúng kể những giấc mơ vô nghĩa. \q Lời an ủi của chúng chẳng ích gì. \q Vì vậy dân chúng lang thang như chiên lạc. \q Họ khốn khổ vì không có người chăn dẫn dắt.

sw.L: Kwa maana terafimu husema uovu, na waaguzi huona uongo; \q nao husimulia ndoto zisizo na maana; \q hufariji bure. \q Kwa hiyo wanatangatanga kama kondoo; \q wanateseka, kwa maana hakuna mchungaji.
sw.B: Kwa maana miungu ya nyumbani husema udanganyifu, na waaguzi huona maono ya uongo; \q husimulia ndoto za uongo \q na kutoa faraja isiyo na kitu. \q Kwa hiyo watu wanatangatanga kama kondoo; \q wanateseka kwa sababu hawana mchungaji.
sw.R: Sanamu za miungu ya nyumbani hutoa majibu yasiyoaminika, na watabiri huona maono ya uongo. \q Husimulia ndoto zisizo na maana yoyote. \q Faraja wanayotoa haifai kitu. \q Kwa hiyo watu wanatangatanga kama kondoo waliopotea. \q Wanateseka kwa sababu hawana mchungaji wa kuwaongoza.

ko.L: 드라빔은 헛된 것을 말하고, 점쟁이들은 거짓을 보며, \q 헛된 꿈을 말하고, \q 헛되이 위로한다. \q 그러므로 그들이 양 떼처럼 떠돌며, \q 목자가 없어 괴로움을 당한다.
ko.B: 집안 신상들은 속이는 말을 하고, 점쟁이들은 거짓 환상을 보며, \q 거짓 꿈을 이야기하고, \q 헛된 위로를 한다. \q 그래서 백성이 양 떼처럼 헤매며, \q 목자가 없어서 고통을 겪는다.
ko.R: 집에 모셔 둔 우상들이 하는 대답은 믿을 수가 없고, 점쟁이들이 보는 환상은 거짓이다. \q 그들이 이야기하는 꿈은 아무 뜻이 없다. \q 그들이 주는 위로는 쓸모가 없다. \q 그래서 백성이 길 잃은 양처럼 헤매고 있다. \q 이끌어 줄 목자가 없어서 고통을 겪고 있다.

pt.L: Porque os terafins falam maldade, e os adivinhos veem mentira; \q e contam sonhos vazios; \q consolam em vão. \q Por isso eles partem como ovelhas; \q são afligidos, porque não há pastor.
pt.B: Pois os ídolos do lar falam engano, e os adivinhos veem mentiras; \q contam sonhos falsos \q e dão um consolo vazio. \q Por isso o povo vagueia como ovelhas; \q sofre porque não tem pastor.
pt.R: Os ídolos da família dão respostas em que não se pode confiar, e os adivinhos têm visões que são mentira. \q Eles contam sonhos que não significam nada. \q O consolo que eles dão não serve para nada. \q Por isso o povo anda perdido como ovelhas. \q Eles sofrem porque não têm um pastor para guiá-los.

am.L: የቤተሰብ አማልክት ክፋትን ይናገራሉና፤ ሟርተኞችም ሐሰትን ያያሉ፤ \q የከንቱነትንም ሕልም ይናገራሉ፤ \q በከንቱ ያጽናናሉ። \q ስለዚህ እንደ በጎች ተቅበዘበዙ፤ \q እረኛ የላቸውምና ተጨነቁ።
am.B: የቤተሰብ አማልክት ማታለያን ይናገራሉ፤ ሟርተኞችም ሐሰትን ያያሉ፤ \q ውሸት የሆነ ሕልምን ይናገራሉ፤ \q ባዶ መጽናናትንም ይሰጣሉ። \q ስለዚህ ሕዝቡ እንደ በጎች ይቅበዘበዛሉ፤ \q እረኛ ስለሌላቸው ይሠቃያሉ።
am.R: የቤተሰብ ጣዖታት የማይታመን መልስ ይሰጣሉ፤ ጠንቋዮችም ሐሰተኛ ራእይ ያያሉ። \q ትርጉም የሌለውን ሕልም ይነግራሉ። \q የሚሰጡት መጽናናት ከንቱ ነው። \q ስለዚህ ሕዝቡ እንደ ጠፉ በጎች ይቅበዘበዛሉ። \q የሚመራቸው እረኛ ስለሌላቸው ይሠቃያሉ።

hi.L: क्योंकि गृह-देवता अनर्थ की बातें कहते हैं, और भावी कहनेवाले झूठ देखते हैं; \q और वे निकम्मे स्वप्न सुनाते हैं; \q वे व्यर्थ शान्ति देते हैं। \q इसलिए वे भेड़ों के समान भटक गए हैं; \q वे दुःख उठाते हैं, क्योंकि कोई चरवाहा नहीं।
hi.B: गृह-देवता छल की बातें बोलते हैं, और भावी कहनेवाले झूठे दर्शन देखते हैं; \q वे झूठे स्वप्न सुनाते हैं \q और खोखली शान्ति देते हैं। \q इसलिए लोग भेड़ों के समान भटक गए हैं; \q वे दुःख उठाते हैं, क्योंकि उनका कोई चरवाहा नहीं।
hi.R: घर में रखी मूरतें ऐसे उत्तर देती हैं जिन पर भरोसा नहीं किया जा सकता, और भविष्य बतानेवाले झूठे दर्शन देखते हैं। \q वे ऐसे सपने सुनाते हैं जिनका कोई अर्थ नहीं। \q उनकी दी हुई तसल्ली बेकार है। \q इसलिए लोग खोई हुई भेड़ों की तरह भटकते हैं। \q वे दुःख उठाते हैं, क्योंकि उनकी अगुवाई करनेवाला कोई चरवाहा नहीं।

ru.L: Ведь терафимы говорят нечестие, и прорицатели видят ложь; \q и сны пустые рассказывают, \q утешают напрасно. \q Поэтому они бредут, как овцы; \q страдают, потому что нет пастуха.
ru.B: Ведь домашние боги говорят обман, а прорицатели видят ложь; \q они рассказывают лживые сны \q и утешают пустыми словами. \q Поэтому народ бредёт, как овцы; \q люди страдают, потому что у них нет пастуха.
ru.R: Домашние идолы дают ответы, которым нельзя верить, а гадатели видят ложные видения. \q Они рассказывают сны, которые ничего не значат. \q Их утешение бесполезно. \q Поэтому народ бродит, как потерянные овцы. \q Люди страдают, потому что у них нет пастуха, который бы их вёл.

ja.L: まことに、家の守り神は不義を語り、占い師は偽りを見る。 \q 彼らはむなしい夢を語り、 \q 空しく慰める。 \q それゆえ、彼らは羊のようにさまよい出て、 \q 苦しむ。羊飼いがいないからだ。
ja.B: 家の守り神は欺きを語り、占い師は偽りを見る。 \q 彼らは偽りの夢を語り、 \q むなしい慰めを与える。 \q それで民は羊のようにさまよい、 \q 羊飼いがいないので苦しむ。
ja.R: 家の守り神の像の答えは、信用できない。占い師が見る幻は、うそだ。 \q 彼らが語る夢には、何の意味もない。 \q 彼らの慰めは、役に立たない。 \q だから民は、迷った羊のようにさまよう。 \q 導く羊飼いがいないので、苦しんでいる。

uk.L: Бо терафими говорять нечестя, а ворожбити бачать неправду; \q і вони розповідають марні сни; \q вони втішають надаремно. \q Тому вони мандрують, як вівці; \q вони страждають, бо немає пастиря.
uk.B: Бо домашні боги говорять оману, а ворожбити бачать брехню; \q вони розповідають неправдиві сни \q і дають порожню втіху. \q Тому народ блукає, як вівці; \q він страждає, бо не має пастуха.
uk.R: Домашні ідоли дають відповіді, яким не можна вірити, а ворожбити бачать брехливі видіння. \q Вони розповідають сни, які нічого не означають. \q Їхня втіха марна. \q Тому народ блукає, як загублені вівці. \q Люди страждають, бо не мають пастуха, який би їх вів.

decisions.choice: the teraphim: household images used to seek guidance
decisions.reason: Teraphim were small images kept in the home (Genesis 31:19, 34) and used to ask for oracles (Ezekiel 21:26). They were condemned with other forms of divination (1 Samuel 15:23; 2 Kings 23:24). The meaning of the name is not known.

decisions.choice: the diviners see falsehood; dreams of worthlessness: the sources the people turned to for guidance are empty
decisions.reason: Diviners claimed to learn the future by signs and omens, a practice the law forbade (Deuteronomy 18:10-14). Dreams could come from God, but the prophets warned against those who told dreams of their own making (Jeremiah 23:25-32; 27:9). What these give is falsehood and "vapor", the word Ecclesiastes uses for what is fleeting and empty.

decisions.choice: like sheep with no shepherd: a people without true leaders
decisions.reason: A flock without a shepherd wanders and comes to harm. The picture is used of Israel without a king or a faithful leader (Numbers 27:17; 1 Kings 22:17; Ezekiel 34:5). In Matthew 9:36 and Mark 6:34 Jesus has compassion on the crowds because they are "like sheep without a shepherd".

decisions.choice: household gods (B); household idols (R); the people wander (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "teraphim"; Balanced and Readable say "household gods" and "household idols", as in Hosea 3:4. Balanced and Readable name "the people" as the ones who wander, which the Hebrew leaves to the context.

decisions.choice: "les téraphim" (L), "les dieux domestiques" (B), "les idoles domestiques" (R)
decisions.reason: As the published French of Ezekiel 21:26, Samuel and Hosea.

decisions.choice: "brebis" (L, B), "moutons" (R); "berger" at every level
decisions.reason: As the term sheet's shepherd and sheep, John 10 and Matthew 26:31.

decisions.choice: "los dioses domésticos" (L); "los ídolos domésticos" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The teraphim follow the Samuel terms note and the Spanish of 1 Samuel 19:13; the diviners are "adivinos", as in 1 Samuel 6:2.

decisions.choice: "terafimu" (L); "miungu ya nyumbani" (B); "sanamu za miungu ya nyumbani" (R); "waaguzi" (L, B), "watabiri" (R)
decisions.reason: As the published Hosea 3:4 for the teraphim, and Micah 3:7 and Jeremiah 27:9 for the diviners.

decisions.choice: "드라빔" (L); "집안 신상들" (B); "집에 모셔 둔 우상들" (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the name used in Genesis and Judges; B and R say what the teraphim were, as the English does.

decisions.choice: teraphim "thê-ra-phim" (L) / "tượng thần gia đình" (B) / "tượng thần trong nhà" (R)
decisions.reason: Published forms (Genesis and Judges have both "thê-ra-phim" and "tượng thần gia đình"); L keeps the Hebrew word, as the English L does.

decisions.choice: terafins (L); ídolos do lar (B); ídolos da família (R)
decisions.reason: The household images (m1) take the wording Hosea 3:4 has in Portuguese at each level: Literal keeps the Hebrew name, and Balanced and Readable say what they were.

decisions.choice: teraphim "የቤተሰብ አማልክት" (L, B), as Hosea 3:4 and Ezekiel 21:26 on main, "የቤተሰብ ጣዖታት" (R); diviners "ሟርተኞች" (L, B), as Jeremiah 27:9; "like sheep ... no shepherd" with the words of Matthew 9:36, "እረኛ እንደሌላቸው በጎች"
decisions.reason: Matthew 9:36 does not quote this verse, but it uses the same picture; the Amharic keeps the same words for it.

decisions.choice: गृह-देवता (L, B), घर में रखी मूरतें (R); भावी कहनेवाले (L, B), भविष्य बतानेवाले (R)
decisions.reason: The teraphim are household images used to seek guidance (meaning m1), गृह-देवता as Judges 17:5 in this translation; the diviners are भावी कहनेवाले, as Jeremiah 27:9. Readable uses everyday words.

decisions.choice: терафимы (L); домашние боги (B); домашние идолы (R)
decisions.reason: Household images used to seek guidance (m1). Literal keeps the Hebrew name; Balanced says "домашние боги", as Genesis 31 in Russian; Readable says "идолы", as the English does.

decisions.choice: как овцы ... нет пастуха
decisions.reason: A people without true leaders (m3); "пастух" as the Gospels' word for the shepherd, which the picture of chapters 10-13 keeps throughout.

decisions.choice: teraphim "家の守り神" (L, B), "家の守り神の像" (R), as Genesis 31 and the notes; qosemim "占い師" (every level); 'awen "不義" (L), "欺き" (B), "信用できない" (R); ro'eh "羊飼い".
decisions.reason: Settled forms in the notes (GEN, 1SA, HAB 'awen 不義 at L); the English B deceit, R cannot be trusted; m3 sheep without a shepherd kept as the picture at every level.

source.text: עַל־הָֽרֹעִים֙ חָרָ֣ה אַפִּ֔י וְעַל־הָעַתּוּדִ֖ים אֶפְק֑וֹד כִּֽי־פָקַד֩ יְהוָ֨ה צְבָא֤וֹת אֶת־עֶדְרוֹ֙ אֶת־בֵּ֣ית יְהוּדָ֔ה וְשָׂ֣ם אוֹתָ֔ם כְּס֥וּס הוֹד֖וֹ בַּמִּלְחָמָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: Against the shepherds burns my anger, and on the male goats I will bring punishment; for Yahweh of hosts visits his flock, the house of Judah, and he will make them like his majestic horse in battle.

en.L: Against the shepherds {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} anger burns, \q and on the male goats I will visit [punishment]; \q for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of hosts has visited {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} flock, the house of Judah, \q and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will set them like {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} majestic horse in battle.
en.B: My anger blazes against the shepherds, \q and I will punish those who lead the flock; \q for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies cares for {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} flock, the house of Judah, \q and will make them like {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} proud war horse in battle.
en.R: I am angry with the shepherds who lead {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people, \q and I will punish those leaders. \q {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies takes care of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} flock, the people of Judah. \q He will make them like {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} proud horse in battle.

fr.L: Contre les bergers {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} colère s’enflamme, \q et sur les boucs je vais intervenir ; \q car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées est intervenu pour {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} troupeau, la maison de Juda, \q et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les rendra semblables à {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} cheval de majesté dans la bataille.
fr.B: Ma colère flambe contre les bergers, \q et je punirai ceux qui mènent le troupeau ; \q car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées prend soin de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} troupeau, la maison de Juda, \q et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} en fera comme {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} fier cheval de guerre dans la bataille.
fr.R: Je suis en colère contre les bergers qui conduisent {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple, \q et je punirai ces chefs. \q {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées prend soin de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} troupeau, le peuple de Juda. \q Il en fera comme {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} fier cheval dans la bataille.

es.L: Contra los pastores arde {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} ira, \q y a los machos cabríos castigaré; \q porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los ejércitos ha visitado a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} rebaño, la casa de Judá, \q y los pondrá como {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} caballo de gala en la batalla.
es.B: Mi ira arde contra los pastores, \q y castigaré a los que guían el rebaño; \q porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos cuida de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} rebaño, la casa de Judá, \q y los hará como {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} orgulloso caballo de guerra en la batalla.
es.R: Estoy enojado con los pastores que guían a {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo, \q y castigaré a esos dirigentes. \q {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos cuida de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} rebaño, el pueblo de Judá. \q Lo hará como {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} orgulloso caballo en la batalla.

vi.L: Cơn giận {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} nổi phừng nghịch cùng những người chăn, \q và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ trừng phạt những con dê đực; \q vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân đã thăm viếng bầy chiên {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, là nhà Giu-đa, \q và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ làm cho họ như con chiến mã oai hùng của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nơi chiến trận.
vi.B: Cơn giận {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} nổi phừng nghịch cùng những người chăn, \q và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ trừng phạt những kẻ dẫn đầu bầy; \q vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân chăm sóc bầy chiên {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, là nhà Giu-đa, \q và sẽ làm cho họ như con chiến mã kiêu hùng của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nơi chiến trận.
vi.R: Ta giận những người chăn đang dẫn dắt dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, \q và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ trừng phạt những người lãnh đạo ấy. \q {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân chăm sóc bầy chiên {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, là dân Giu-đa. \q Ngài sẽ làm cho họ như con ngựa kiêu hùng của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nơi chiến trận.

sw.L: Hasira {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} inawaka dhidi ya wachungaji, \q na juu ya mabeberu nitaleta [adhabu]; \q kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi amelijia kundi {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}, nyumba ya Yuda, \q {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} atawafanya kama farasi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} wa fahari vitani.
sw.B: Hasira {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} inawaka dhidi ya wachungaji, \q {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} nitawaadhibu wale wanaoliongoza kundi; \q kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi analitunza kundi {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}, nyumba ya Yuda, \q {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} atawafanya kama farasi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} wa vita mwenye fahari.
sw.R: Nimewakasirikia wachungaji wanaowaongoza watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, \q {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} nitawaadhibu viongozi hao. \q {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi analitunza kundi {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}, watu wa Yuda. \q Atawafanya kama farasi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} hodari vitani.

ko.L: 목자들에게 내 분노가 불타오르니, \q 내가 숫염소들을 벌하겠다. \q 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 자기 양 떼인 유다 집을 돌보았으니, \q 그들을 전쟁터의 자기 위엄 있는 말처럼 만들 것이다.
ko.B: 내 분노가 목자들에게 불타오른다. \q 내가 양 떼를 이끄는 자들을 벌하겠다. \q 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 자기 양 떼인 유다 집을 돌보니, \q 그들을 전쟁터에 나선 자기의 늠름한 군마처럼 만들 것이다.
ko.R: 나는 내 백성을 이끄는 목자들에게 몹시 화가 나 있다. \q 나는 그 지도자들을 벌하겠다. \q 하늘의 군대를 거느린 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 자기 양 떼인 유다 백성을 돌본다. \q 그들을 전쟁터에 나선 늠름한 말처럼 만들겠다.

pt.L: Contra os pastores se acende a {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} ira, \q e sobre os bodes trarei [castigo]; \q porque {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos visitou o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} rebanho, a casa de Judá, \q e {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} os fará como o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} cavalo majestoso na batalha.
pt.B: A {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} ira arde contra os pastores, \q e castigarei os que guiam o rebanho; \q porque {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos cuida do {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} rebanho, a casa de Judá, \q e os fará como o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} orgulhoso cavalo de guerra na batalha.
pt.R: Estou irado com os pastores que guiam o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo, \q e vou castigar esses líderes. \q {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos cuida do {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} rebanho, o povo de Judá. \q Ele vai fazer deles o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} cavalo valente na batalha.

am.L: ቁጣዬ በእረኞች ላይ ነደደ፤ \q በአውራ ፍየሎችም ላይ እቀጣለሁ፤ \q {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ጸባኦት መንጋውን፣ የይሁዳን ቤት ጎብኝቷልና፤ \q በጦርነትም እንደ ክቡር ፈረሱ ያደርጋቸዋል።
am.B: ቁጣዬ በእረኞች ላይ ነድዷል፤ \q መንጋውን የሚመሩትንም እቀጣለሁ፤ \q የሠራዊት አምላክ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} መንጋውን፣ የይሁዳን ቤት ይንከባከባልና፤ \q በጦርነትም እንደ ኩሩ የጦር ፈረሱ ያደርጋቸዋል።
am.R: ሕዝቤን በሚመሩ እረኞች ላይ ተቆጥቻለሁ፤ \q እነዚያንም መሪዎች እቀጣለሁ። \q የሠራዊት አምላክ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} መንጋውን፣ የይሁዳን ሕዝብ ይንከባከባል። \q በጦርነት እንደ ኩሩ ፈረሱ ያደርጋቸዋል።

hi.L: चरवाहों पर मेरा क्रोध भड़का है, \q और बकरों को मैं दंड दूँगा; \q क्योंकि सेनाओं के {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने अपने झुंड, यहूदा के घराने की सुधि ली है, \q और वे उन्हें युद्ध में अपने शानदार घोड़े के समान बनाएँगे।
hi.B: मेरा क्रोध चरवाहों पर भड़क उठा है, \q और मैं झुंड के अगुवों को दंड दूँगा; \q क्योंकि सेनाओं के {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} अपने झुंड, यहूदा के घराने की देखभाल करते हैं, \q और उन्हें युद्ध में अपने गर्वीले घोड़े के समान बनाएँगे।
hi.R: मैं उन चरवाहों पर क्रोधित हूँ जो मेरी प्रजा की अगुवाई करते हैं, \q और मैं उन अगुवों को दंड दूँगा। \q सेनाओं के {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} अपने झुंड, यहूदा के लोगों की देखभाल करते हैं। \q वे उन्हें युद्ध में अपने गर्वीले घोड़े के समान बना देंगे।

ru.L: На пастухов пылает {{deity_pronoun:мой|Мой}} гнев, \q и козлов {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} накажу; \q ведь {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} Саваоф посетил своё стадо, дом Иуды, \q и сделает их, как своего величественного коня в битве.
ru.B: Мой гнев пылает на пастухов, \q и {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} накажу вожаков стада; \q ведь {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} Саваоф заботится о своём стаде, доме Иуды, \q и сделает их подобными своему гордому боевому коню.
ru.R: Я гневаюсь на пастухов, которые ведут {{deity_pronoun:мой|Мой}} народ, \q и {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} накажу этих вождей. \q {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} Воинств заботится о своём стаде, о народе Иуды. \q Он сделает их похожими на своего гордого коня в битве.

ja.L: 羊飼いたちに対して、わたしの怒りは燃え、 \q 雄やぎどもを、わたしは罰する。 \q まことに、万軍の{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は、その群れ、ユダの家を顧みた。 \q そして彼らを、戦いにおけるその威厳ある馬のようにする。
ja.B: わたしの怒りは羊飼いたちに対して燃え上がり、 \q 群れを導く者たちを、わたしは罰する。 \q 万軍の{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}が、その群れであるユダの家を顧み、 \q 彼らを戦いの誇り高い軍馬のようにするからだ。
ja.R: わたしは、わたしの民を導く羊飼いたちに怒っている。 \q わたしは、その指導者たちを罰する。 \q 天の軍勢を率いる{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は、その群れであるユダの人々を世話し、 \q 彼らを、戦いに出る誇り高い馬のようにする。

uk.L: На пастирів палає {{deity_pronoun:мій|Мій}} гнів, \q і козлів {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} покараю; \q бо {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} Саваот відвідав свою отару, дім Юди, \q і зробить їх, як свого величного коня в бою.
uk.B: Мій гнів палає на пастухів, \q і {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} покараю тих, хто веде отару; \q бо {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} Небесних Військ дбає про свою отару, дім Юди, \q і зробить їх, як свого гордого бойового коня в бою.
uk.R: Я гніваюся на пастухів, що ведуть {{deity_pronoun:мій|Мій}} народ, \q і {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} покараю цих провідників. \q {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} Вседержитель дбає про свою отару, народ Юди. \q Він зробить їх, як свого гордого коня в бою.

decisions.choice: the shepherds and the male goats: the leaders of the people
decisions.reason: In the ancient Near East kings and rulers were called shepherds of their people (Jeremiah 23:1-4; Ezekiel 34:2-10). The male goats lead the flock, and the word is used for leaders and chiefs (Isaiah 14:9; Ezekiel 34:17). These are the leaders who let the people wander (verse 2). The text does not say who they were.

decisions.choice: I will punish ... the LORD has visited: one verb, two senses
decisions.reason: The same verb is used twice. It means to look after someone, or to call someone to account. The LORD will call the leaders to account, and he has come to care for his flock. The play on the verb shows that his judgment on the leaders is his care for the people.

decisions.choice: like his majestic horse in battle: the weak flock becomes a war horse
decisions.reason: The sheep without a shepherd become the LORD's own war horse, splendid and fearless (Job 39:19-25). The LORD rides out to battle with his people (9:13-14).

decisions.choice: the male goats (L); the leaders of the flock (B); those leaders (R); the LORD of Armies (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "male goats"; Balanced and Readable say what they stand for (m1). "The LORD of hosts" follows the wording set in Isaiah. Readable says "my people" for the flock the shepherds lead; the LORD is speaking, so "my" takes the deity_pronoun setting.

decisions.choice: "intervenir" (L) for paqad, against the goats and for the flock
decisions.reason: One French verb for both senses, as the meaning decision notes; "visiter" no longer carries punishment in French.

decisions.choice: "만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 … 돌보았으니", without -시-, and "자기 양 떼"
decisions.reason: God is still speaking ("my anger") and names himself in the third person; in his own mouth his name takes no honorific (term sheet), so "께서" and "그분의" are not used here.

decisions.choice: "숫염소들" (L); "양 떼를 이끄는 자들" (B); "지도자들" (R)
decisions.reason: The male goats are the leaders (meaning decision); Literal keeps the image.

decisions.choice: "trừng phạt" ... "thăm viếng" for the one verb paqad
decisions.reason: Vietnamese has no one verb for both senses; the meaning decision gives the play on the word.

decisions.choice: "machos cabríos" (L); "los que guían el rebaño" (B); "esos dirigentes" (R); "castigaré ... ha visitado" (L)
decisions.reason: The leaders are pictured as he-goats at L; B and R give the sense. L keeps the play of the one verb (paqad) as "castigar" and "visitar" in their two senses; B and R say "cuida".

decisions.choice: "wachungaji" at every level; "mabeberu" (L) for the male goats; "wale wanaoliongoza kundi" (B), "viongozi" (R)
decisions.reason: The term sheet keeps "wachungaji" for the shepherds (rulers); Literal keeps the image of the he-goats, and the other levels name the leaders, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "nitaleta [adhabu]" ... "amelijia" (L); "nitawaadhibu" ... "analitunza" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew uses one verb ("visit") for punishing the leaders and caring for the flock; Swahili has no single verb with both senses, and the meaning decision explains it.

decisions.choice: os bodes (L); os que guiam o rebanho (B); esses líderes (R); trarei [castigo] ... visitou (L)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "bodes", the male goats that lead a flock (m1), and Balanced and Readable say what they stand for, as the English does (r-en-1). Literal keeps the one verb in its two senses (m2) as far as Portuguese can, "visitou" for the LORD's care; Balanced and Readable say "castigar" and "cuidar".

decisions.choice: the one verb paqad as "እቀጣለሁ" (I will punish) and "ጎብኝቷል" (L) / "ይንከባከባል" (B, R) (he has visited, cares for)
decisions.reason: Amharic has no verb that means both "punish" and "visit with care", the two senses the meaning decision names, so each clause gets its own word; Literal keeps "ጎብኝቷል" for the LORD's visit to his flock.

decisions.choice: दंड दूँगा ... सुधि ली है / देखभाल करते हैं
decisions.reason: One Hebrew verb (paqad) means both "punish" and "care for" here (meaning m2). Hindi has no single verb for both, so each sense gets its own word; the male goats are the leaders (meaning m1), बकरे at Literal and अगुवे at Balanced and Readable.

decisions.choice: козлы (L); вожаки стада (B); эти вожди (R)
decisions.reason: The male goats that lead the flock are the leaders of the people (m1); Literal keeps the animals, the other levels say who is meant, as the English does.

decisions.choice: накажу ... посетил (L)
decisions.reason: One Hebrew verb is used in two senses, to punish and to care for (m2); Literal keeps "посетил", which in Bible Russian carries both, the other levels give each sense.

decisions.choice: 'attudim "雄やぎども" (L), "群れを導く者たち" (B), "その指導者たち" (R); 'efqod / paqad "罰する" / "顧みる" (the one verb in two senses, m2, not imitated in Japanese); sus hodo "威厳ある馬" (L), "誇り高い軍馬" (B), "誇り高い馬" (R).
decisions.reason: m1 and the English levels; the LORD named inside his own speech takes no respect form (顧みる, する), as the JER and MAL notes.

source.text: מִמֶּ֤נּוּ פִנָּה֙ מִמֶּ֣נּוּ יָתֵ֔ד מִמֶּ֖נּוּ קֶ֣שֶׁת מִלְחָמָ֑ה מִמֶּ֛נּוּ יֵצֵ֥א כָל־נוֹגֵ֖שׂ יַחְדָּֽו׃

records.literal_gloss: From him [the] corner, from him [the] peg, from him [the] bow of battle; from him will go out every ruler together.

en.L: From him [will come the] cornerstone, from him [the] tent peg, \q from him [the] bow of battle; \q from him will go out every ruler together.
en.B: From Judah will come the cornerstone, from Judah the tent peg, \q from Judah the battle bow; \q from Judah every ruler will come.
en.R: From the people of Judah will come a leader like a cornerstone, and one like a tent peg, \q and one like a bow used in battle. \q Every ruler will come from them.

fr.L: De lui [viendra la] pierre d’angle, de lui [le] piquet de tente, \q de lui [l’]arc de guerre ; \q de lui sortiront tous les chefs ensemble.
fr.B: De Juda viendra la pierre d’angle, de Juda le piquet de tente, \q de Juda l’arc de guerre ; \q de Juda sortiront tous les chefs.
fr.R: Du peuple de Juda viendra un chef qui sera comme une pierre d’angle, un autre comme un piquet de tente, \q un autre comme un arc de guerre. \q Tous les chefs viendront de ce peuple.

es.L: De él [saldrá la] piedra angular, de él [la] estaca de la tienda, \q de él [el] arco de guerra; \q de él saldrá todo gobernante a una.
es.B: De Judá saldrá la piedra angular, de Judá la estaca de la tienda, \q de Judá el arco de guerra; \q de Judá saldrán todos los gobernantes.
es.R: Del pueblo de Judá saldrá un dirigente que será como una piedra angular, y otro como una estaca de tienda, \q y otro como un arco de guerra. \q Todos los gobernantes saldrán de ellos.

vi.L: Từ nó [sẽ ra] đá góc nhà, từ nó [ra] cọc lều, \q từ nó [ra] cung chiến trận; \q từ nó sẽ ra mọi người cai trị cùng nhau.
vi.B: Từ Giu-đa sẽ ra đá góc nhà, từ Giu-đa ra cọc lều, \q từ Giu-đa ra cung chiến trận; \q từ Giu-đa sẽ ra mọi người cai trị.
vi.R: Từ dân Giu-đa sẽ xuất hiện một người lãnh đạo như đá góc nhà, một người như cọc lều, \q và một người như cây cung dùng trong chiến trận. \q Mọi người cai trị đều sẽ ra từ họ.

sw.L: Kutoka kwake [litatoka] jiwe la pembeni, kutoka kwake kigingi cha hema, \q kutoka kwake upinde wa vita; \q kutoka kwake atatoka kila mtawala pamoja.
sw.B: Kutoka Yuda litatoka jiwe la pembeni, kutoka Yuda kigingi cha hema, \q kutoka Yuda upinde wa vita; \q kutoka Yuda atatoka kila mtawala.
sw.R: Kutoka kwa watu wa Yuda atatoka kiongozi aliye kama jiwe la pembeni, na mmoja aliye kama kigingi cha hema, \q na mmoja aliye kama upinde wa vita. \q Kila mtawala atatoka kwao.

ko.L: 그에게서 모퉁잇돌이, 그에게서 장막 말뚝이, \q 그에게서 전쟁의 활이 [나오고], \q 그에게서 모든 통치자가 함께 나올 것이다.
ko.B: 유다에게서 모퉁잇돌이 나오고, 유다에게서 장막 말뚝이 나오며, \q 유다에게서 전쟁에 쓰는 활이 나오고, \q 유다에게서 모든 통치자가 나올 것이다.
ko.R: 유다 백성 가운데서 모퉁잇돌 같은 지도자와 장막 말뚝 같은 지도자가 나올 것이다. \q 전쟁에 쓰는 활 같은 지도자도 나올 것이다. \q 모든 통치자가 그들 가운데서 나올 것이다.

pt.L: Dele [virá a] pedra angular, dele [a] estaca, \q dele [o] arco de guerra; \q dele sairá todo governante, juntamente.
pt.B: De Judá virá a pedra angular, de Judá a estaca da tenda, \q de Judá o arco de guerra; \q de Judá virá todo governante.
pt.R: Do povo de Judá vai sair um líder que será como uma pedra angular, e outro como uma estaca de tenda, \q e outro como um arco de guerra. \q Todos os governantes vão sair dele.

am.L: ከእርሱ የማዕዘን ድንጋይ፣ ከእርሱ የድንኳን ካስማ፣ \q ከእርሱ የጦርነት ቀስት [ይወጣል]፤ \q ከእርሱ አለቃ ሁሉ በአንድነት ይወጣል።
am.B: የማዕዘኑ ድንጋይ ከይሁዳ፣ የድንኳኑ ካስማ ከይሁዳ፣ \q የጦርነቱ ቀስት ከይሁዳ ይወጣል፤ \q አለቃ ሁሉ ከይሁዳ ይወጣል።
am.R: ከይሁዳ ሕዝብ እንደ ማዕዘን ድንጋይ የሆነ መሪ፣ እንደ ድንኳን ካስማም የሆነ ይወጣል፤ \q በጦርነት እንደሚያገለግል ቀስት የሆነም ይወጣል። \q ገዥዎች ሁሉ ከእነርሱ ይወጣሉ።

hi.L: उसी से कोने का पत्थर, उसी से खूँटी, \q उसी से युद्ध का धनुष [निकलेगा]; \q उसी से हर एक शासक एक साथ निकलेगा।
hi.B: यहूदा से ही कोने का पत्थर निकलेगा, यहूदा से ही तंबू की खूँटी, \q यहूदा से ही युद्ध का धनुष; \q यहूदा से ही हर शासक निकलेगा।
hi.R: यहूदा के लोगों में से एक ऐसा अगुवा निकलेगा जो कोने के पत्थर के समान होगा, और एक जो तंबू की खूँटी के समान, \q और एक जो युद्ध में चलाए जानेवाले धनुष के समान। \q हर शासक उन्हीं में से निकलेगा।

ru.L: Из него — угол, из него — кол, \q из него — лук боевой; \q из него выйдет всякий правитель вместе.
ru.B: Из Иуды выйдет краеугольный камень, из Иуды — кол для шатра, \q из Иуды — боевой лук; \q из Иуды выйдут все правители.
ru.R: Из народа Иуды выйдет вождь, подобный краеугольному камню, и вождь, подобный колу для шатра, \q и вождь, подобный боевому луку. \q Все правители выйдут из них.

ja.L: 彼から隅の石が、彼から杭が、 \q 彼から戦いの弓が[出る]。 \q 彼から、すべての支配者が共に出て来る。
ja.B: ユダから隅の親石が、ユダからテントの杭が、 \q ユダから戦いの弓が出る。 \q ユダから、すべての支配者が出る。
ja.R: ユダの人々の中から、隅の石のような指導者が出る。テントの杭のような者も、 \q 戦いで使う弓のような者も出る。 \q すべての支配者は、彼らの中から出る。

uk.L: Від нього [вийде] наріжний камінь, від нього кілок намету, \q від нього бойовий лук; \q від нього вийде кожен правитель разом.
uk.B: Від Юди вийде наріжний камінь, від Юди кілок намету, \q від Юди бойовий лук; \q від Юди вийде кожен правитель.
uk.R: З народу Юди вийде провідник, як наріжний камінь, і провідник, як кілок намету, \q і провідник, як лук, яким воюють. \q З них вийде кожен правитель.

decisions.choice: from him: from Judah
decisions.reason: "Him" refers back to the house of Judah in verse 3. The new leaders will come from God's people itself, in place of the shepherds who failed.

decisions.choice: the cornerstone, the tent peg, the battle bow: leaders who hold the people together and fight for them
decisions.reason: Each picture stands for a leader. The cornerstone holds up a building (Psalm 118:22; Isaiah 28:16), and "the corners" of the people are its leaders (Judges 20:2; 1 Samuel 14:38). The tent peg holds a tent firm; Isaiah 22:23 calls Eliakim a peg driven into a firm place, on whom his family hangs. The battle bow is the leader in war.

decisions.choice: every ruler: every kind of leader
decisions.reason: The word usually means an oppressor or taskmaster, as in 9:8 and Exodus 3:7. Here it seems to mean a ruler in a good sense, one with power to command (Isaiah 60:17 uses it of rulers who bring peace). Some read it as the rulers who will oppress Judah's enemies.

decisions.choice: from Judah (B); From the people of Judah ... a leader like (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced repeats "Judah" for "him" (m1); Readable also says that the pictures are of leaders (m2).

decisions.choice: "la piedra angular"; "la estaca de la tienda"
decisions.reason: The cornerstone and tent peg are pictures of leaders who hold the people together; the images are kept at every level.

decisions.choice: a pedra angular; a estaca (da tenda); o arco de guerra
decisions.reason: The three pictures of leaders (m2): "pedra angular", the word Psalm 118:22 and Isaiah 28:16 have in Portuguese; "estaca" for the tent peg, as in Isaiah 22:23; "arco de guerra" as in 9:10.

decisions.choice: उसी से (L); यहूदा से ही (B); यहूदा के लोगों में से (R)
decisions.reason: "From him" means from Judah (meaning m1); Balanced and Readable name Judah, as the English does. The cornerstone, peg and bow are leaders who hold the people together and fight for them (meaning m2).

decisions.choice: угол, кол (L); краеугольный камень, кол для шатра (B, R)
decisions.reason: Leaders who hold the people together and fight for them (m2); Literal keeps the bare Hebrew nouns, with "угол" for the cornerstone, the other levels name the things.

decisions.choice: pinnah "隅の石" (L, R), "隅の親石" (B), as Job 38:6; yated "杭" (L), "テントの杭" (B, R); qeshet milchamah "戦いの弓"; nogesh "支配者" (every level; at 9:8 the same word is "虐げる者").
decisions.reason: m2 and the English levels; m3 (uncertain) reads nogesh here as every kind of leader, so the oppressor sense of 9:8 is not used.

source.text: וְהָי֨וּ כְגִבֹּרִ֜ים בּוֹסִ֨ים בְּטִ֤יט חוּצוֹת֙ בַּמִּלְחָמָ֔ה וְנִ֨לְחֲמ֔וּ כִּ֥י יְהוָ֖ה עִמָּ֑ם וְהֹבִ֖ישׁוּ רֹכְבֵ֥י סוּסִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And they will be like warriors trampling in [the] mud of [the] streets in battle, and they will fight, for Yahweh [is] with them, and they will put to shame riders of horses.

en.L: And they will be like warriors trampling in the mud of [the] streets in battle; \q and they will fight, \q for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} [is] with them, \q and they will put to shame [the] riders on horses.
en.B: They will be like warriors in battle, trampling the enemy into the mud of the streets. \q They will fight, \q since {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is with them, \q and the horsemen will be put to shame.
en.R: They will be like soldiers in battle who trample their enemies into the mud of the streets. \q They will fight, \q and {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will be with them. \q They will defeat the enemy's horsemen.

fr.L: Et ils seront comme des guerriers qui piétinent dans la boue des rues pendant la bataille ; \q et ils combattront, \q car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} [est] avec eux, \q et ils couvriront de honte les cavaliers sur les chevaux.
fr.B: Ils seront comme des guerriers au combat, qui piétinent l’ennemi dans la boue des rues. \q Ils combattront, \q puisque {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est avec eux, \q et les cavaliers seront couverts de honte.
fr.R: Ils seront comme des soldats dans la bataille, qui écrasent leurs ennemis dans la boue des rues. \q Ils combattront, \q et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} sera avec eux. \q Ils vaincront les cavaliers ennemis.

es.L: Y serán como guerreros que pisotean en el lodo de [las] calles en la batalla; \q y pelearán, \q porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} [está] con ellos, \q y avergonzarán a [los] jinetes de caballos.
es.B: Serán como guerreros en la batalla, que pisotean al enemigo en el lodo de las calles. \q Pelearán, \q porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} está con ellos, \q y los jinetes quedarán avergonzados.
es.R: Serán como soldados en la batalla, que pisotean a sus enemigos en el lodo de las calles. \q Pelearán, \q y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} estará con ellos. \q Vencerán a los jinetes del enemigo.

vi.L: Họ sẽ như những dũng sĩ giày đạp trong bùn [ngoài] đường nơi chiến trận; \q họ sẽ chiến đấu, \q vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} [ở] với họ, \q và họ sẽ làm cho những kẻ cưỡi ngựa phải hổ thẹn.
vi.B: Họ sẽ như những dũng sĩ nơi chiến trận, giày đạp kẻ thù xuống bùn ngoài đường phố. \q Họ sẽ chiến đấu, \q vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ở với họ, \q và những kẻ cưỡi ngựa sẽ phải hổ thẹn.
vi.R: Họ sẽ như những người lính trong trận chiến, giày đạp kẻ thù xuống bùn ngoài đường. \q Họ sẽ chiến đấu, \q và {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ ở với họ. \q Họ sẽ đánh bại kỵ binh của kẻ thù.

sw.L: Nao watakuwa kama mashujaa wanaokanyaga katika matope ya njiani vitani; \q nao watapigana, \q kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} [yuko] pamoja nao, \q nao watawaaibisha wapanda farasi.
sw.B: Watakuwa kama mashujaa vitani, wakiwakanyaga adui katika matope ya njiani. \q Watapigana, \q kwa kuwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} yuko pamoja nao, \q nao wapanda farasi wataaibishwa.
sw.R: Watakuwa kama askari vitani wanaowakanyaga adui zao katika matope ya barabarani. \q Watapigana, \q naye {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atakuwa pamoja nao. \q Watawashinda wapanda farasi wa adui.

ko.L: 그들은 전쟁 때에 거리의 진흙을 짓밟는 용사들 같을 것이다. \q 그들이 싸울 것이니, \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그들과 함께 계시기 때문이다. \q 그들이 말 탄 자들을 부끄럽게 할 것이다.
ko.B: 그들은 전쟁에서 원수를 거리의 진흙처럼 짓밟는 용사들 같을 것이다. \q 그들이 싸울 것이다. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그들과 함께 계시기 때문이다. \q 말 탄 자들이 부끄러움을 당할 것이다.
ko.R: 그들은 원수들을 거리의 진흙 속에 짓밟는 군인들 같을 것이다. \q 그들이 싸울 것이다. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그들과 함께 계실 것이다. \q 그들은 원수의 기병들을 이길 것이다.

pt.L: E serão como guerreiros que pisam na lama das ruas na batalha; \q e lutarão, \q porque {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} [está] com eles, \q e envergonharão os cavaleiros dos cavalos.
pt.B: Serão como guerreiros na batalha, pisando o inimigo na lama das ruas. \q Lutarão, \q pois {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} está com eles, \q e os cavaleiros serão envergonhados.
pt.R: Eles vão ser como soldados na batalha que pisam os inimigos na lama das ruas. \q Eles vão lutar, \q e {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} vai estar com eles. \q Eles vão vencer os cavaleiros do inimigo.

am.L: በጦርነትም በመንገድ ጭቃ ውስጥ እንደሚረግጡ ኃያላን ይሆናሉ፤ \q ይዋጋሉም፤ \q {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ከእነርሱ ጋር [ነው]ና፤ \q በፈረሶችም ላይ የሚቀመጡትን ያሳፍራሉ።
am.B: በጦርነት ጠላትን በመንገድ ጭቃ ውስጥ እንደሚረግጡ ጦረኞች ይሆናሉ። \q ይዋጋሉ፤ \q {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ከእነርሱ ጋር ነውና፤ \q ፈረሰኞቹም ያፍራሉ።
am.R: በጦርነት ጠላቶቻቸውን በመንገድ ጭቃ ውስጥ እንደሚረግጡ ወታደሮች ይሆናሉ። \q ይዋጋሉ፤ \q {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}ም ከእነርሱ ጋር ይሆናል። \q የጠላትን ፈረሰኞች ድል ያደርጋሉ።

hi.L: और वे उन शूरवीरों के समान होंगे जो युद्ध में सड़कों के कीचड़ में रौंदते हैं; \q और वे लड़ेंगे, \q क्योंकि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} उनके साथ [हैं], \q और वे घुड़सवारों को लज्जित करेंगे।
hi.B: वे युद्ध में उन शूरवीरों के समान होंगे जो शत्रु को गलियों के कीचड़ में रौंद डालते हैं। \q वे लड़ेंगे, \q क्योंकि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} उनके साथ हैं, \q और घुड़सवार लज्जित किए जाएँगे।
hi.R: वे युद्ध में उन सैनिकों के समान होंगे जो अपने शत्रुओं को गलियों के कीचड़ में रौंद डालते हैं। \q वे लड़ेंगे, \q और {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} उनके साथ होंगे। \q वे शत्रु के घुड़सवारों को हरा देंगे।

ru.L: И будут они как воины, попирающие [врагов] в грязи улиц в битве; \q и будут сражаться, \q потому что {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} с ними, \q и посрамят всадников на конях.
ru.B: Они будут как воины в битве, втаптывающие врага в грязь улиц. \q Они будут сражаться, \q потому что {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} с ними, \q и всадники будут посрамлены.
ru.R: Они будут как воины в битве, которые втаптывают врагов в грязь на улицах. \q Они будут сражаться, \q и {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} будет с ними. \q Они разобьют вражеских всадников.

ja.L: 彼らは、戦いで通りの泥を踏みつける勇士のようになる。 \q 彼らは戦う。 \q {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}が彼らと共にいるからだ。 \q 彼らは馬に乗る者たちを恥じ入らせる。
ja.B: 彼らは、戦いで敵を通りの泥の中に踏みつける勇士のようになる。 \q 彼らは戦う。 \q {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}が彼らと共にいるからだ。 \q 騎兵たちは恥を見る。
ja.R: 彼らは、戦いで敵を通りの泥の中に踏みつける兵士のようになる。 \q 彼らは戦う。 \q {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}が彼らと共にいる。 \q 彼らは、敵の騎兵を打ち負かす。

uk.L: І вони будуть, як воїни, що топчуть у болоті вулиць у бою; \q і вони битимуться, \q бо {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} з ними, \q і вони осоромлять вершників на конях.
uk.B: Вони будуть, як воїни в бою, що втоптують ворога в болото вулиць. \q Вони битимуться, \q бо {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} з ними, \q і вершники будуть осоромлені.
uk.R: Вони будуть, як воїни в бою, що втоптують своїх ворогів у болото вулиць. \q Вони битимуться, \q і {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} буде з ними. \q Вони переможуть ворожих вершників.

decisions.choice: trampling in the mud of the streets: treading down their enemies like mud
decisions.reason: Conquered enemies are pictured as mud trodden down in the streets (2 Samuel 22:43; Micah 7:10). The warriors of Judah trample their foes as easily as they walk through the mud.

decisions.choice: they will fight, for the LORD is with them: the victory is his
decisions.reason: Judah's people fight, but they win because the LORD is with them, as he was with Israel in its battles of old (Joshua 1:5; Judges 6:16).

decisions.choice: the riders on horses: the enemy's cavalry
decisions.reason: Horses and chariots were the strength of great armies, and Judah had little of either (9:10). The foot soldiers of Judah will put the enemy's horsemen to shame, the reverse of what anyone would expect (Psalm 20:8).

decisions.choice: trampling the enemy into the mud (B); their enemies; the enemy's horsemen (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable supply the object of "trampling" (m1). Readable says "defeat" for "put to shame" and names the horsemen as the enemy's (m3).

source.text: וְגִבַּרְתִּ֣י׀אֶת־בֵּ֣ית יְהוּדָ֗ה וְאֶת־בֵּ֤ית יוֹסֵף֙ אוֹשִׁ֔יעַ וְהֽוֹשְׁבוֹתִים֙ כִּ֣י רִֽחַמְתִּ֔ים וְהָי֖וּ כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹֽא־זְנַחְתִּ֑ים כִּ֗י אֲנִ֛י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיהֶ֖ם וְאֶעֱנֵֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And I will strengthen [the] house of Judah, and [the] house of Joseph I will save; and I will bring them back, for I have compassion on them, and they will be as [if] I had not rejected them; for I [am] Yahweh their God, and I will answer them.

en.L: And I will strengthen the house of Judah, and the house of Joseph I will save; \q and I will bring them back, for I have had compassion on them, \q and they will be as [if] I had not spurned them; \q because I [am] {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} their God, and I will answer them.
en.B: I will make the house of Judah strong and save the house of Joseph. \q I will bring them back, because I have compassion on them, \q and it will be as if I had never cast them off. \q I am {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} their God, and I will answer them.
en.R: I will make the people of Judah strong, and I will rescue the northern tribes of Israel. \q I will bring them home, because I feel deep love for them. \q It will be as if I had never turned them away. \q I am {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} their God, and I will answer when they call to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}.

fr.L: Et je fortifierai la maison de Juda, et la maison de Joseph, je la sauverai ; \q et je les ramènerai, car j’ai eu compassion d’eux, \q et ils seront comme [si] je ne les avais pas rejetés ; \q car je [suis] {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} leur Dieu, et je leur répondrai.
fr.B: Je rendrai forte la maison de Juda et je sauverai la maison de Joseph. \q Je les ramènerai, car j’ai compassion d’eux, \q et ce sera comme si je ne les avais jamais rejetés. \q Je suis {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} leur Dieu, et je leur répondrai.
fr.R: Je rendrai fort le peuple de Juda, et je délivrerai les tribus du nord d’Israël. \q Je les ramènerai chez eux, parce que je les aime profondément. \q Ce sera comme si je ne les avais jamais repoussés. \q Je suis {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} leur Dieu, et je leur répondrai quand ils {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}appelleront.

es.L: Y fortaleceré la casa de Judá, y la casa de José salvaré; \q y los haré volver, porque he tenido compasión de ellos, \q y serán como [si] no los hubiera desechado; \q porque yo [soy] {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} su Dios, y les responderé.
es.B: Haré fuerte a la casa de Judá y salvaré a la casa de José. \q Los traeré de vuelta, porque tengo compasión de ellos, \q y será como si nunca los hubiera rechazado. \q Yo soy {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} su Dios, y les responderé.
es.R: Haré fuerte al pueblo de Judá, y rescataré a las tribus del norte de Israel. \q Los traeré de vuelta a casa, porque los amo profundamente. \q Será como si nunca los hubiera rechazado. \q Yo soy {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} su Dios, y les responderé cuando {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} llamen.

vi.L: Ta sẽ làm cho nhà Giu-đa mạnh mẽ, và nhà Giô-sép {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ giải cứu; \q {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ đem họ trở về, vì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã thương xót họ, \q và họ sẽ như [thể] {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} chưa từng ruồng bỏ họ; \q vì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} [là] {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của họ, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ đáp lời họ.
vi.B: Ta sẽ làm cho nhà Giu-đa mạnh mẽ và giải cứu nhà Giô-sép. \q Ta sẽ đem họ trở về, vì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} thương xót họ, \q và sẽ như thể {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} chưa từng ruồng bỏ họ. \q Ta là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của họ, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ đáp lời họ.
vi.R: Ta sẽ làm cho dân Giu-đa mạnh mẽ, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ giải cứu các chi tộc phía bắc của Y-sơ-ra-ên. \q Ta sẽ đem họ về nhà, vì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} hết lòng thương yêu họ. \q Sẽ như thể {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} chưa bao giờ xua đuổi họ. \q Ta là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của họ, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ đáp lời khi họ kêu cầu {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.

sw.L: Nami nitaitia nguvu nyumba ya Yuda, na nyumba ya Yusufu nitaiokoa; \q {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} nitawarudisha, kwa maana nimewahurumia, \q nao watakuwa kana kwamba sikuwatupa; \q kwa sababu {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} [ni] {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wao, {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} nitawajibu.
sw.B: Nitaifanya nyumba ya Yuda kuwa na nguvu na kuiokoa nyumba ya Yusufu. \q Nitawarudisha kwa sababu ninawahurumia, \q na itakuwa kana kwamba sikuwahi kuwatupa. \q Mimi ni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wao, {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} nitawajibu.
sw.R: Nitawafanya watu wa Yuda kuwa na nguvu, {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} nitayaokoa makabila ya kaskazini ya Israeli. \q Nitawarudisha nyumbani kwa sababu ninawapenda sana. \q Itakuwa kana kwamba sikuwahi kuwakataa. \q Mimi ni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wao, {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} nitawajibu wanaponiita.

ko.L: 내가 유다 집을 강하게 하고, 요셉 집을 구원하겠다. \q 내가 그들을 불쌍히 여기니, 그들을 돌아오게 하겠다. \q 그들은 내가 버린 적이 없었던 것처럼 될 것이다. \q 나는 그들의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}이니, 그들에게 응답하겠다.
ko.B: 내가 유다 집을 강하게 하고, 요셉 집을 구원하겠다. \q 내가 그들을 불쌍히 여기니, 그들을 다시 데려오겠다. \q 그들은 내가 한 번도 버린 적이 없었던 것처럼 될 것이다. \q 나는 그들의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}이다. 내가 그들에게 응답하겠다.
ko.R: 나는 유다 백성을 강하게 하고, 북쪽 이스라엘 지파들을 구해 내겠다. \q 나는 그들을 몹시 불쌍히 여기니, 그들을 고향으로 데려오겠다. \q 그들은 내가 한 번도 내친 적이 없었던 것처럼 될 것이다. \q 나는 그들의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}이다. 그들이 나를 부르면 내가 대답하겠다.

pt.L: E fortalecerei a casa de Judá, e a casa de José salvarei; \q e os farei voltar, porque tive compaixão deles, \q e serão como [se] eu não os tivesse rejeitado; \q porque eu [sou] {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus deles, e lhes responderei.
pt.B: Tornarei forte a casa de Judá e salvarei a casa de José. \q Eu os trarei de volta, porque tenho compaixão deles, \q e será como se eu nunca os tivesse rejeitado. \q Eu sou {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus deles, e lhes responderei.
pt.R: Vou tornar forte o povo de Judá e vou salvar as tribos do norte de Israel. \q Vou trazê-los para casa, porque tenho um amor profundo por eles. \q Vai ser como se eu nunca os tivesse mandado embora. \q Eu sou {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus deles, e vou responder quando clamarem a {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}}.

am.L: የይሁዳንም ቤት አበረታለሁ፤ የዮሴፍንም ቤት አድናለሁ፤ \q ራርቼላቸዋለሁና እመልሳቸዋለሁ፤ \q እንዳልጣልኳቸውም ይሆናሉ፤ \q እኔ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} አምላካቸው ነኝና፤ እመልስላቸዋለሁም።
am.B: የይሁዳን ቤት አበረታለሁ፤ የዮሴፍንም ቤት አድናለሁ። \q ስለምራራላቸው እመልሳቸዋለሁ፤ \q ፈጽሞ እንዳልጣልኳቸውም ይሆናል። \q እኔ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} አምላካቸው ነኝ፤ እመልስላቸዋለሁ።
am.R: የይሁዳን ሕዝብ አበረታለሁ፤ የሰሜንን የእስራኤል ነገዶችም እታደጋለሁ። \q በጣም ስለምወዳቸው ወደ አገራቸው እመልሳቸዋለሁ። \q ፈጽሞ እንዳልገፋኋቸው ይሆናል። \q እኔ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} አምላካቸው ነኝ፤ ወደ እኔ ሲጣሩም እመልስላቸዋለሁ።

hi.L: और मैं यहूदा के घराने को बलवन्त करूँगा, और यूसुफ़ के घराने का उद्धार करूँगा; \q और मैं उन्हें लौटा लाऊँगा, क्योंकि मुझे उन पर दया आई है, \q और वे ऐसे होंगे मानो मैंने उन्हें कभी त्यागा ही न था; \q क्योंकि मैं {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} उनका परमेश्वर हूँ, और मैं उन्हें उत्तर दूँगा।
hi.B: मैं यहूदा के घराने को बलवन्त करूँगा और यूसुफ़ के घराने को बचाऊँगा। \q मैं उन्हें लौटा लाऊँगा, क्योंकि मुझे उन पर दया आती है, \q और ऐसा होगा मानो मैंने उन्हें कभी त्यागा ही न हो। \q मैं {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} उनका परमेश्वर हूँ, और मैं उन्हें उत्तर दूँगा।
hi.R: मैं यहूदा के लोगों को बलवन्त करूँगा, और इस्राएल के उत्तरी गोत्रों को बचाऊँगा। \q मैं उन्हें घर लौटा लाऊँगा, क्योंकि मैं उनसे गहरा प्रेम करता हूँ। \q ऐसा होगा मानो मैंने उन्हें कभी दूर किया ही न था। \q मैं {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} उनका परमेश्वर हूँ, और जब वे मुझे पुकारेंगे, तो मैं उन्हें उत्तर दूँगा।

ru.L: И {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} укреплю дом Иуды, и дом Иосифа спасу; \q и верну их, потому что {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} сжалился над ними, \q и будут они, как [если бы] {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} не отвергал их; \q ведь {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} — {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, их Бог, и отвечу им.
ru.B: Я укреплю дом Иуды и спасу дом Иосифа. \q Я верну их, потому что {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} сжалился над ними, \q и будет так, как будто {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} никогда их не отвергал. \q Я — {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, их Бог, и {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} отвечу им.
ru.R: Я сделаю народ Иуды сильным и спасу северные колена Израиля. \q Я верну их домой, потому что {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} глубоко их люблю. \q Будет так, как будто {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} никогда их не отвергал. \q Я — {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, их Бог, и {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} отвечу им, когда они позовут {{deity_pronoun:меня|Меня}}.

ja.L: わたしはユダの家を強くし、ヨセフの家を救う。 \q わたしは彼らを連れ戻す。わたしが彼らをあわれんだからだ。 \q 彼らは、わたしが退けなかったかのようになる。 \q まことに、わたしは彼らの神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}であり、彼らに答える。
ja.B: わたしはユダの家を強くし、ヨセフの家を救う。 \q わたしは彼らを連れ戻す。彼らをあわれむからだ。 \q 彼らは、わたしが一度も捨てたことがなかったかのようになる。 \q わたしは彼らの神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}であり、彼らに答える。
ja.R: わたしはユダの人々を強くし、北のイスラエルの部族を救い出す。 \q わたしは彼らを故郷に連れ帰る。彼らを深く愛しているからだ。 \q わたしが彼らを追い払ったことなど、なかったかのようになる。 \q わたしは彼らの神である{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}だ。彼らがわたしを呼ぶとき、わたしは答える。

uk.L: І {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} зміцню дім Юди, і дім Йосифа {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} врятую; \q і {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} поверну їх, бо {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} змилосердився над ними, \q і вони будуть, наче {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} не відкидав їх; \q бо {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} — {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, їхній Бог, і {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} відповім їм.
uk.B: Я зроблю дім Юди сильним і врятую дім Йосифа. \q Я поверну їх, бо {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} маю милосердя до них, \q і буде так, наче {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} ніколи їх не відкидав. \q Я — {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, їхній Бог, і {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} відповім їм.
uk.R: Я зроблю народ Юди сильним і визволю північні племена Ізраїля. \q Я поверну їх додому, бо {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} глибоко люблю їх. \q Буде так, наче {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} ніколи їх не відкидав. \q Я — {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, їхній Бог, і {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} відповім, коли вони кликатимуть {{deity_pronoun:мене|Мене}}.

decisions.choice: the house of Joseph: the northern tribes of Israel
decisions.reason: Joseph was the father of Ephraim and Manasseh, the largest of the northern tribes. "The house of Joseph" stands for the northern kingdom, also called Ephraim (verse 7), whose people had been carried off by Assyria. Judah and Joseph together are the whole people (Ezekiel 37:16-19).

decisions.choice: I will bring them back: one of two readings combined in the written form
alternatives: I will settle them (in their land)
decisions.reason: The written Hebrew form looks like a blend of two verbs: "I will bring them back" and "I will make them dwell". The reading tradition and most ancient translations take the first, which is followed here, as in verse 10. The second would mean "I will settle them" in their land. Either way the LORD restores his people.

decisions.choice: I have compassion on them ... as though I had not rejected them: a full restoring
decisions.reason: The verb for compassion is the tender love of a parent (Psalm 103:13); it is the word in the name of Hosea's daughter Lo-ruhamah (Hosea 1:6; 2:25). The LORD will take his people back as if he had never cast them off.

decisions.choice: I am the LORD their God, and I will answer them: the covenant bond renewed
decisions.reason: "I am the LORD their God" is the language of the covenant (Exodus 6:7; Leviticus 26:44-45). To "answer" is to hear prayer and act on it (13:9; Isaiah 58:9).

decisions.choice: the northern tribes of Israel; I feel deep love for them; I will answer when they call to me (R)
decisions.reason: Readable explains "the house of Joseph" (m1) and "answer" (m4). The LORD is speaking of himself, so "me" takes the deity_pronoun setting.

decisions.choice: "la casa de José" (L, B); "las tribus del norte de Israel" (R)
decisions.reason: The house of Joseph is the northern kingdom; R says so, as the English R does.

decisions.choice: "불쌍히 여기다" (L, B); "몹시 불쌍히 여기다" (R)
decisions.reason: The verb of rachamim is "불쌍히 여기다" (term sheet). "나는 … {{divine_name:주|야훼}}이다" uses the copula written in full, which reads after both forms.

decisions.choice: "họ" for the people in this promise
decisions.reason: The term sheet: "chúng" for Israel under judgment, "họ" in promises, as in Jeremiah.

decisions.choice: "mimi" and "nami" with the deity_pronoun span in the middle of a sentence; "Mimi" opening a sentence (B, R) written plainly
decisions.reason: The English has no span on this "I", but a free Swahili pronoun that means God takes the span wherever it stands in the middle of a sentence (the book-wide rule at 1:3). At Balanced and Readable "Mimi" opens the sentence and is written plainly with its capital.

decisions.choice: a casa de José (L, B); as tribos do norte de Israel (R)
decisions.reason: The northern tribes (m1) are "a casa de José" at Literal and Balanced, and Readable says who they were, as the English Readable does (r-en-1).

decisions.choice: "I will bring them back" "እመልሳቸዋለሁ" and "I will answer them" "እመልስላቸዋለሁ"
decisions.reason: Both Amharic verbs come from መለሰ; the object form (bring back) and the dative form (answer) are distinct words in Amharic, and the closing words "I am the LORD their God, and I will answer them" are said plainly at every level.

decisions.choice: यूसुफ़ का घराना (L, B); इस्राएल के उत्तरी गोत्र (R)
decisions.reason: The house of Joseph is the northern tribes of Israel (meaning m1); Literal and Balanced keep the name, as the history books do, and Readable says who is meant, as the English does.

decisions.choice: дом Иосифа (L, B); северные колена Израиля (R)
